name: Yellowstone County Summer Jobs Program
what_you_do: Get a paid summer job with a local employer. You also do a paid work skills training before summer and get an adult mentor.
who_can_apply: High school students and recent graduates, ages 16 to 19 (from the 2024 report).
pay_detail: Paid positions. The wage is not stated.
deadline_text: No current dates on the program page. The article is from August 2024.
how_to_apply: The program page does not describe a student sign-up. Contact Big Sky Economic Development in Billings to ask how to join.
notes: Based on an August 2024 report that says 34 students finished in 2024. Ask Big Sky Economic Development if the program still runs.
